name: ADNI: Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative
description: The Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) is a landmark, longitudinal multicenter observational study launched in 2004 by the National Institute on Aging (NIA) and private partners to track the progression of mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and early Alzheimer's disease (AD). The dataset aggregates serial multimodal neuroimaging (structural and functional MRI, amyloid and tau PET), clinical assessments, cognitive test scores, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and blood biomarkers, and whole-genome sequencing from thousands of participants across four continuous study phases (ADNI-1, ADNI-GO, ADNI-2, and ADNI-3). Access is governed by the ADNI Data Use Agreement (DUA) through the Laboratory of Neuro Imaging (LONI) Image and Data Archive (IDA), requiring user registration, credentialing, and agreement to strict non-redistribution and non-reidentification rules.

license.name: ADNI Data Use Agreement
license.notes: Access requires a formal data access application and acceptance of the ADNI Data Use Agreement via the LONI IDA platform. Redistribution of raw participant-level data is prohibited. Access is restricted to scientific investigation and research purposes.
